summary:
All tests pass. The `grep` warnings are harmless cosmetic issues in the test script (it calls `grep -Fq "-> Company {"` which the shell interpreted with `>` as a redirect — but the exit codes were correct because neither failing condition was hit).

**The bug:** In `codegen.rs:74`, the `FieldType::Ref` getter generated `-> Company {` (owned return type) in the signature while the body returned `&self.company` (a reference). The fix was adding `&` before the type name: `-> &{type_name}`.
